about: Files under lib/ that still hold a holiday list of their own. Which days an organisation does not work is one fact and ADR-022 puts it in the engine working calendar; a second list here is a second answer, and the two diverge the first time an administrator adds a closure in one of them. An entry names the file, the change that retires the copy, and why it is still here. NoLocalCalendarTest fails on an entry missing either, and fails in the OTHER direction on a file that has stopped holding one, so the list can only shrink deliberately.

entries.reason: The one copy, and it is now the degraded path for EVERY caller rather than for the statutory roll alone. WorkingDayCalculator asks the administered calendar through WorkingDayRoll and answers from this list only when no calendar is answering, which it says once in the log. Until 2026-09-19 the header claimed as much while thirteen callers, a complaint deadline and a KCC callback among them, still read the list directly. What keeps the file here is that an instance without OpenRegister must still compute a date, and a Dutch national list is a better answer than none.
